package.name: dsh_ros2_rviz_offscreen
package.description: Headless RViz2 scene renderer for dsh-ros2: drives the real rviz rendering stack (rviz_common + OGRE) on a virtual X display (Xvfb) and publishes the rendered scene as a sensor_msgs/Image topic — no physical display, no window stacking; images come from the render kernel, never from screenshots.
